purpose.statement: A notification template holds Client Connector notification settings and is assigned to groups of users through the app profile.

quotes: You assign a notification template to an app profile
After you create a template, you can assign it to the Notification Template in the app profile to apply the notification settings to a group of users.

availability.statement: There are two types of template. A Modern template sets, for each selected platform, which individual notifications or groups of notifications display and for how long; users can only pause them with Do not Disturb. Modern templates need Client Connector 5.0 and later and are enabled by Zscaler Support. A Legacy template sets which notification types display, users can turn some notifications on or off, and it applies to versions earlier than 5.0. Templates became generally available in May 2026, and on Windows 4.8 to 4.10 additional templates can be created and assigned to Windows app profiles.

quotes: Modern: Provides options to control which individual notifications or groups of notifications display and for how long for each selected platform.

End users can’t manually change which notifications display from the app and can only temporarily pause them using Do not Disturb. Available for Zscaler Client Connector versions 5.0 and later. Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.

Legacy: Provides options to control which notification types display (but not how the individual notifications display). End users can manually enable or disable some notifications. Available for Zscaler Client Connector versions earlier than 5.0.
Zscaler made notification templates generally available in May 2026.
For Zscaler Client Connector versions 4.8 to 4.10 for Windows, you can create additional templates and assign them to Windows app profiles.

replaces-tab.statement: Existing settings from the End User Notifications tab were migrated to a Legacy Notification Settings template, whose name cannot be changed.

quotes: Existing global settings to enable default, app update, Internet & SaaS (ZIA), and Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication notifications as well as persistence settings from the End User Notifications tab were migrated to a Legacy Notification Settings template
You cannot change the default Legacy Notification Settings template name.

older-clients-legacy.statement: An app profile's template applies only to Client Connector 4.8 and later for Windows; users on 4.7 or earlier get the Legacy Notification Settings template whatever the profile selects.

quotes: If you assign an app profile with a notification template to users with Zscaler Client Connector version 4.7 or earlier, the Legacy Notification Settings template is used regardless of what is selected.

android-profiles.statement: An Android app profile has a Notification Template option, available only for Client Connector 5.0 and later for Android; the same entry says users on 4.2 or earlier get the Legacy Notification Settings template whatever is selected.

quotes: Notification Template: Select one of your configured notification templates from the drop-down menu.

This option is available only for Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for Android. If you assign an app profile with a notification template to users with Zscaler Client Connector version 4.2 or earlier, the Legacy Notification Settings template is used regardless of what is selected.

app-profile-binding.statement: In the API an application profile carries its template as `notificationTemplateId` and embeds the template's settings as `notificationTemplateContract`, whose integer `zpaReauthNotificationTime` the contract describes as whether the ZPA reauthentication notification at a specific time interval is enabled.
app-profile-binding.conditions: Corrected (v5 item 2): previously named zpaReauthNotificationTime without its description, which read as the interval itself; the contract describes it as an enabled flag.

expect.description: The ID of the notification template.
Indicates whether ZPA reauthentication notification at a specific time interval is enabled.

same-settings.statement: A template carries the same switches as the global tab: pop-ups by default (users can turn them off in the More window), app updates, service status, ZIA notifications, ZPA reauthentication and its 2 to 1440 minute interval, the 5 to 60 second timer and persistent notifications.

quotes: Show Zscaler Client Connector Notification Popups by Default: Select this option to have users receive pop-up notifications from Zscaler Client Connector.
This setting is enabled after a user is enrolled. Users can turn this option off from Zscaler Client Connector in the More window in the app.
Enable App Updates Notifications: Select this option to have users receive app upgrade notifications.
Enable Service Status Notifications: Select this option to have users receive status notifications for Zscaler services
Enable ZIA Notifications: Select this option to have users receive notifications from Internet & SaaS (ZIA)
Enable Notifications for ZPA reauthentication: Select this option to have users prompted for authentication.
Enter a value from 2 to 1440 to set the interval in minutes.
Enter the value from 5 to 60 to set the number of seconds that Zscaler Client Connector pop-up notifications display.

zia-persistent-endpoint-dlp.statement: In a template, ZIA Notification Persistent makes Endpoint DLP notifications persistent.

quotes: ZIA Notification Persistent: When enabled, overrides the Custom Timer and makes Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) notifications persistent.

posture-delay.statement: Delay Posture Failure Notifications holds back device posture failure pop-ups for up to 300 seconds (default 0), so that a check that fails only while, for example, CrowdStrike is still starting does not alarm the user. It delays only the pop-up, not the message in the app's Notifications window.

quotes: When enabled, Zscaler Client Connector delays pop-up notifications for device posture failure for the number of entered seconds after a system reboot. The default value is 0. You can enter a value up to 300.
because CrowdStrike is still starting, the device posture check fails temporarily
This option delays only the pop-up notification (not the message that displays in the Notifications window in the app).

do-not-disturb.statement: Do not Disturb adds a Do not Disturb button to Client Connector pop-ups. It is disabled by default, applies only to Windows and macOS, and needs the Zscaler Notification Framework. It is a Common Setting of the template; where Modern templates are not enabled on the tenant, it is set in the legacy settings.

quotes: Do not Disturb: Enable to include a Do not Disturb button on Zscaler Client Connector pop-up notifications. The default value is disabled. Applies only to Zscaler Client Connector for Windows and macOS and the Zscaler notification framework must be enabled.

If the Modern template feature isn't enabled on your tenant, the Common Settings section doesn't display. You can set the pop-up duration in the Custom Timer (In Seconds) field and enable the Do not disturb setting in the legacy settings.

zia-channels.statement: ZIA Firewall, DNS and IPS notifications can each be shown in the app's Notifications window and, separately, as pop-ups; all three also need Enable ZIA Notifications.

quotes: ZIA Firewall: Select this option to show firewall notifications from Internet & SaaS in the Notifications window in the app. If enabled, you can select Firewall Popup Notifications to also display them as pop-up notifications.

DNS: Select this option to show DNS notifications from Internet & SaaS in the Notifications window in the app. If enabled, you can select DNS Popup Notifications to also display them as pop-up notifications.

IPS: Select this option to show IPS notifications from Internet & SaaS in the Notifications window in the app. If enabled, you can select IPS Popup Notifications to also display them as pop-up notifications.
You must also select Enable ZIA Notifications to display the ZIA Firewall, DNS, and IPS notifications for users.

posture-remediation.statement: Show Device Posture Failure Remediation Notification shows a pop-up when a Private Access app is blocked because a posture in the access policy failed and the access policy enables Device Posture Failure Notification; its Learn More link opens the posture profile's message in the app.

quotes: Select this option to show a pop-up notification if a Private Access app is blocked because a device posture that is included in an access policy fails and Device Posture Failure Notification is enabled on the access policy.

If this option is enabled, the pop-up notification from Private Access displays and includes a Learn More link that, when clicked, opens the Zscaler Client Connector app and displays the Message from the Device Posture Profile in the Notifications window.

go-model-fields.statement: The Go SDK's template model nests ZIA settings (firewall, DNS and IPS, each with a pop-up flag, plus persistence) under `ziaNotificationTemplate` and ZPA settings (posture failure, reauthentication, its interval and the posture-failure delay) under `zpaNotificationTemplate`, beside top-level fields such as `isDefaultTemplate`, `durationInSeconds` and `enableDoNotDisturb`.

field-to-setting.statement: The model fields correspond by name to the console settings: `durationInSeconds` to Custom Timer, `enableDoNotDisturb` to Do not disturb, `delayPostureFailureSeconds` to the posture-failure delay, and `enableDevicePostureFailure` to a posture-failure notification switch.
field-to-setting.conditions: Name correspondence only; no captured source maps the API fields to the console settings. The template contract embedded in application profiles has a posture-failure switch of its own, showDevicePostureFailureNotification, which supports that the template holds such a switch but uses a different name.

expect.description: Indicates whether device posture failure notification is shown.

python-no-service.statement: The Python SDK has no notification-template service; its application-profile model only carries the assigned template's ID and contract.
python-no-service.conditions: Rests on a search of the Python SDK at the pin: no module under zscaler/zcc calls the notification-templates endpoint.

delay-trigger.title: What the posture-failure delay counts from
delay-trigger.detail: The setting is named Delay Posture Failure Notifications after Tunnel Establishment, but its description says the delay applies after a system reboot, and the worked example counts from the reboot.

template-schema.title: Notification template schema and options
template-schema.resolution: The Configuring Notification Templates article is now captured: claims purpose, availability, replaces-tab, same-settings, posture-delay, do-not-disturb, zia-channels and posture-remediation, with app-profile-binding for per-profile assignment. Branding comes from the app profile's custom theme (zcc.notifications:custom-theme); language is in zcc.notifications.localization.

per-profile-reauth-interval.title: A per-App-Profile ZPA reauthentication interval
per-profile-reauth-interval.resolution: The interval is a template setting (same-settings) and templates are assigned per app profile (purpose), on Legacy-tab settings; which clients a template reaches is in availability, older-clients-legacy and android-profiles. The application profile embeds the template as notificationTemplateContract (app-profile-binding).

posture-failure-notification.title: A notification for device posture failure
posture-failure-notification.resolution: Templates delay posture-failure pop-ups (posture-delay) and can show a remediation pop-up when a posture failure blocks a Private Access app (posture-remediation).

default-template.title: Whether a template can be the default for new app profiles
default-template.detail: The templates page used to have a Default option to make a template other than the Legacy Notification Settings template the default for new app profiles; the current page has no such option, but the Go SDK's template model still carries `isDefaultTemplate` (go-model-fields).
